'''Grazdoc''' was a [[Nebalite]] trader in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Whenever he needed a face-to-face agent, he sent his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[X-17-D]]. At some point, he was kidnapped by raiders.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
